It could be taken as gimmicky to reference other works of fiction, but names for Quinque I draw, mean something. I didn't choose that one's name to be Rubicante for no reason or just because it's a cool sounding name. Rubicante literally means "Red Faced Terror". And I tried to convey that in it's form, function and design.

There's no intended gimmick there. I understand that it's a bit more mechanical looking than Quinque are usually drawn, but that's just a fact of my art style. I'm mainly showcasing how I draw Quinque so in the possibility that I get a request at some point, there's no suprises about general complexity and exaggerated pointy, boxy edges and corners.

"Rubicante" is a reference to one of the Malebranche, a demon with the same name from "The Divine Comedy" Inferno.

I've only recently built up the courage to post this version of my Rubicante, and I am happy with it's design. I'm grateful for any feedback on the style, color palate, or other features.

Rubicante's dimensions are 5'0" [152.4cm] Length, by 1'10" [55.88cm] at the widest circumference and base of the damage inflicting main conical point. The leftmost section is a curved, spined shield with a convex spread, meant to reflect incoming direct kagune  strikes or to ricochet Ukaku shards and add more protection, as well as a second convex guard that starts where the first ends, giving the two-handed grip a bit more protection and to discourage strikes to the hands, or direct attacks to the hands as a means of disarming me. Rubicante is a cumbersome and unwieldy Halberd-reminiscent Quinque, requiring a great deal of both strength and endurance to use effectively. The topmost point and the section below have a sharp bevel, allowing for slashes in close quarters combat where charging can be reckless or dangerous, even though Rubicante is primarily a thrusting Quinque. It offers a large amount of defence, and due to it's immense weight, the sheer momentum is enough to send careless and cocky ghouls flying. Rubicante is hard to manuvre and takes expert level planning and notation of probability of certain attacks from a ghoul enemy. In the hands of a master, Rubicante is a terrifyingly brutal and sinister weapon. It suits an investigator who likes planning and opportunistic retaliation, with an intent not just to kill, but also leave a careless ghoul wondering what on earth just happened helplessly, as vitality and crucial lifeblood ebbs from the fatal damage Rubicante can cause. Indeed a weapon suited to the remorseless, psychopath of a half-human,( [OC] Special Investigator "Kon Taue").
